syntax.note: Transpile/syntax scan, not a full project semantic typecheck.

strict_typecheck.scope: lib/demo-helper: config, state, store, assistant-events, enquiry-preview; framework-independent logic only

desktop_core: Real Apex homepage is the landing content
No sidebar wrapper or shrunken demonstration site
Actual website remains full width
Desktop helper can be dragged away from the page controls
Keyboard arrow repositioning works
Home restores default position
Guide minimises to a launcher without changing page
Task prepares the supported knowledge prompt
Preparing a prompt never sends it automatically
A typed answer alone does not complete the navigation task
Following the offered page completes task one
Page navigation closes the floating assistant to reveal destination
Price request contains actual roof area and defined scope
Real pricing milestone is separate from enquiry completion
Enquiry loads the priced session details before advancing
Assistant pricing task finishes only at the enquiry preview
Assistant enquiry preview transmits no contact or attachment data
Assistant confirmation explicitly says nothing was sent
Task three enters the actual three-route tool chooser
Helper minimises while the homeowner uses the quick tool
Quick engine output advances to the next enquiry instruction
Quick task finishes at its complete enquiry preview
Quick enquiry transmits no customer or file data
Advanced measurement route is explained, not required
Plan/image route mentions known scale and reuses measured quantities
Three core tasks lead to recap without forcing the admin task
No uncaught browser errors through the full three-task component flow
mobile_admin_and_navigation: Mobile Apex homepage has no horizontal overflow
Mobile helper docks above chat without hiding the composer
Helper rail and message composer do not overlap
Mobile assistant does not widen the page
Unavailable live assistant remains incomplete with a clear error, not a fake reply
Mobile skip is explicitly labelled as skipped
Mobile tool entry leaves the page clear
Mobile roof cards fit the viewport
Mobile result shows the price and a clear enquiry CTA
Mobile helper minimises on form input focus
Optional plan is represented by filename only
Mobile quick estimate reaches a qualified enquiry preview
Mobile enquiry summary stays within viewport
Explicit admin demo link enters the safe demo account in one click
Admin exposes clear local-only and sample-data disclosure
Optional task completes when the actual trade panel is visible
Mobile business controls remain inside the viewport
No uncaught browser errors through mobile enquiry and admin
Expanded helper remains inside viewport after a resize
Detailed tool retains the consistent Apex header
Advanced entry mounts without an uncaught component error
Tool chooser works at 320px width
Small viewport has no uncaught browser errors
assistant_range_preview: Assistant enquiry review retains both configured range endpoints
Contact step confirms both range scenarios carry forward
Enquiry receipt preserves the same range and VAT basis
Range enquiry stays within mobile viewport without component errors
optional_advanced_enquiry: Optional advanced tool produces a clearly labelled local enquiry receipt
Advanced enquiry performs no external upload or submission request
Advanced receipt includes the selected plan filename without uploading the file
Advanced enquiry preview fits mobile without component errors

browser_checks.react_runtime: 18.2 standalone component harness; production package pins 19.2.1
browser_checks.api_fixture_note: Assistant success/SSE/session data are explicit test fixtures. The sample single price is produced by the real deterministic engine. A second endpoint is synthetic only for range-presentation testing. No success fixtures are bundled in the delivered HTML preview.
browser_checks.storage_note: The browser automation harness supplies in-memory storage in opaque pages; production and delivered preview use browser storage with the existing fallbacks.
